fact: Actor lookup from request path is a plain string prefix match, not segment-bounded; a shorter actor name can match a longer one.
Keycloak deployments are cached per realm only; on a cache hit the client name is ignored, so actors sharing a realm reuse the first cached client.
The React UI generator reads debugPrint from the template context (ThreadLocalContextHolder variable), set through templateParameters in the pom, not templateVariables.
The i18n extra fragment is public/i18n/application_default_extra.fragment.hbs (folder spelled i18n).
Column customizers register under TABLE_COLUMN_CUSTOMIZER_HOOK_INTERFACE_KEY; TABLE_ROW_HIGHLIGHTING_HOOK_INTERFACE_KEY is for row highlighting.
Each page generates its own <PAGE_NAME>_PAGE_ACTIONS_HOOK_INTERFACE_KEY; there is no shared page actions key.
Each container generates its own <CONTAINER_NAME>_CONTAINER_ACTIONS_HOOK_INTERFACE_KEY; there is no shared container actions key.
NavigationInterceptor.decorateNavigation has type (to: string | Partial<Path>) => string | Partial<Path>.
judo.sh import_postgres: the dumps variable assignment emits no output, so the piped xargs/sort step receives no dump list.
Generated TypeScript REST client parses yyyy-MM-dd strings with new Date(), which is UTC midnight; in negative UTC offsets the date shows one day earlier.
Generated project toolchain pins are java=21.0.4-zulu and maven=3.9.9 (.sdkmanrc template).
All interceptors for an operation run in registration order for both preCall and postCall; postCall is not reversed.
cxfJaxRsServerUrl is injected but never read by the CXF JAX-RS server provider; it has no effect.
cxfReturnRuntimeExceptions and cxfIncludeBusinessCause have no effect; the RuntimeExceptionMapperProvider is never bound.
CORS options (corsAllowOrigin and related) have no effect; the CORS filter provider returns an unconfigured filter.
cxfLogException is injected but never read by the payload message body writer; it has no effect.
HSQLDB port, databaseName and databasePath options are not applied; configureOptions() is never called by configure().
Jetty thread pool options (maxThreads, minThreads, idleTimeout) are not passed to the Jetty container; only port and contextPath are.
Keycloak realm synchronizer settings are injected under @Named keys that the Keycloak module does not bind, so the settings do not reach the synchronizer.
The HSQLDB Dialect is always bound to a new HsqldbDialect instance; configured overrides and singleton scope do not apply.
Jetty idleTimeout is passed unchanged to QueuedThreadPool, which takes milliseconds, so the documented seconds value is read as milliseconds.
judo.sh install_bundles pipes newline-delimited find output into xargs -0, so frontend POM paths are not found.
Filestore maxSize settings are in kB, but the upload request check compares the raw Content-Length in bytes against the limit.
The UploadAction POST path calls parsePostRequest with no token validator, so upload tokens are not checked on that path.
Generated EC keys always use the P-521 curve, whatever ES256 or ES384 algorithm is configured.
Upload tokens are parsed whenever a TokenValidator is bound, even when the tokenRequired flag is false.
